chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
Cut away evil from the chest of others by snatching (it) away from your own chest.
ai.seo_question: How can I effectively correct the faults of others according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: In this concise maxim from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) employs the agricultural metaphor of 'harvesting' to illustrate that external correction is only effective when rooted in internal sincerity. This reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on *tazkiyah* (purification of the self) as the prerequisite for *tarbiyah* (guidance of others), ensuring that one's judgment is not clouded by the very faults one seeks to correct in others. The instruction underscores the principle that true authority in moral leadership derives from personal integrity rather than mere rhetorical power.
